lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਾਗਹੀਨ ਮਤਿ ਫੀਕੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਤ ਆਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਰੋਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: duramat bhaagaheen mat pheeke naam sunat aavai man rohai ||
lines.translation: Evil-minded, unfortunate and shallow-minded are those who feel anger in their minds, when they hear the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਊਆ ਕਾਗ ਕਉ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਖਾਇ ਮੁਖਿ ਗੋਹੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kaooaa kaag kau a(n)mrit ras paaeeai tripatai visataa khaai mukh gohai ||3||
lines.translation: You may place ambrosial nectar before crows and ravens, but they will be satisfied only by eating manure and dung with their mouths. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਵਾਦੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਨਾਤੈ ਕਊਆ ਹੰਸੁ ਹੋਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit sar satigur sativaadee jit naatai kaooaa ha(n)s hohai ||
lines.translation: The True Guru, the Speaker of Truth, is the pool of Ambrosial Nectar; bathing within it, the crow becomes a swan.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਵਡੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਹੈ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak dhan dha(n)n vade vadabhaagee jinh guramat naam ridai mal dhohai ||4||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, blessed, blessed and very fortunate are those who, through the Guru's Teachings, with the Naam, wash away the filth of their hearts. ||4||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Goojaree, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਊਤਮ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jan ootam ootam baanee mukh bolahi paraupakaare ||
lines.translation: The humble servants of the Lord are exalted, and exalted is their speech. With their mouths, they speak for the benefit of others.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਸੁਣੈ ਸਰਧਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jo jan sunai saradhaa bhagat setee kar kirapaa har nisataare ||1||
lines.translation: Those who listen to them with faith and devotion, are blessed by the Lord; showering His Mercy, He saves them. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮੇਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam mo kau har jan mel piaare ||
lines.translation: Lord, please, let me meet the beloved servants of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere preetam praan satigur gur pooraa ham paapee gur nisataare ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The True Guru, the Perfect Guru, is my Beloved, my very breath of life; the Guru has saved me, the sinner. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਵਡਭਾਗੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh vadabhaagee vadabhaage jin har har naam adhaare ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs are fortunate, so very fortunate; their Support is the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: har har a(n)mrit har ras paavahi guramat bhagat bha(n)daare ||2||
lines.translation: They obtain the Ambrosial Nectar of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; through the Guru's Teachings, they obtain this treasure-house of devotional worship. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਜਮਿ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin darasan satigur sat purakh na paaiaa te bhaagaheen jam maare ||
lines.translation: Those who do not obtain the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the True Guru, the True Primal Being, are most unfortunate; they are destroyed by the Messenger of Death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਕੂਕਰ ਸੂਕਰ ਗਰਧਭ ਪਵਹਿ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨੀ ਦਯਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਮਹਾ ਹਤਿਆਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: se kookar sookar garadhabh pavahi garabh jonee day maare mahaa hatiaare ||3||
lines.translation: They are like dogs, pigs and jackasses; they are cast into the womb of reincarnation, and the Lord strikes them down as the worst of murderers. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਹੋਹੁ ਜਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: deen daiaal hohu jan oopar kar kirapaa lehu ubaare ||
lines.translation: O Lord, Kind to the poor, please shower Your mercy upon Your humble servant, and save him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jan har kee saranaaee har bhaavai har nisataare ||4||3||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak has entered the Lord's Sanctuary; if it pleases You, Lord, please save him. ||4||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Goojaree, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਹਉ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: hohu daiaal meraa man laavahu hau anadin raam naam nit dhiaaee ||
lines.translation: Be Merciful and attune my mind, so that I might meditate continually on the Lord's Name, night and day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਭਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਜਪਿਐ ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sabh sukh sabh gun sabh nidhaan har jit japiai dukh bhukh sabh lahi jaaee ||1||
lines.translation: The Lord is all peace, all virtue and all wealth; remembering Him, all misery and hunger depart. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: man mere meraa raam naam sakhaa har bhaaee ||
lines.translation: O my mind, the Lord's Name is my companion and brother.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਾ ਅੰਤਿ ਬੇਲੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramat raam naam jas gaavaa a(n)t belee daragah lae chhadaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Under Guru's Instruction, I sing the Praises of the Lord's Name; it shall be my help and support in the end, and it shall deliver me in the Court of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੋਚ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) aape daataa prabh a(n)tarajaamee kar kirapaa loch merai man laaee ||
lines.translation: You Yourself are the Giver, O God, Inner-knower, Searcher of hearts; by Your Grace, You have infused longing for You in my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਲੋਚ ਲਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਲੋਚ ਪੂਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: mai man tan loch lagee har setee prabh loch pooree satigur saranaaee ||2||
lines.translation: My mind and body long for the Lord; God has fulfilled my longing. I have entered the Sanctuary of the True Guru. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਪੁੰਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: maanas janam pu(n)n kar paaiaa bin naavai dhrig dhrig birathaa jaaee ||
lines.translation: Human birth is obtained through good actions; without the Name, it is cursed, totally cursed, and it passes away in vain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਦੁਖੁ ਖਾਵੈ ਮੁਖੁ ਫੀਕਾ ਥੁਕ ਥੂਕ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naam binaa ras kas dukh khaavai mukh pheekaa thuk thook mukh paaee ||3||
lines.translation: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one obtains only suffering for his delicacies to eat. His mouth is insipid, and his face is spat upon, again and again. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾ ਤਿਨ ਦਰਗਹ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo jan har prabh har har saranaa tin daragah har har de vadiaaee ||
lines.translation: Those humble beings, who have entered the Sanctuary of the Lord God, Har, Har, are blessed with glory in the Court of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਕਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਈ ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)n dha(n)n saabaas kahai prabh jan kau jan naanak mel lae gal laaee ||4||4||
lines.translation: Blessed, blessed and congratulations, says God to His humble servant. O servant Nanak, He embraces him, and blends him with Himself. ||4||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Goojaree, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਜੀਵਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh sakhee sahelee meree mo kau devahu daan har praan jeevaaiaa ||
lines.translation: O Gurmukhs, O my friends and companions, give me the gift of the Lord's Name, the life of my very life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਹੋਵਹ ਲਾਲੇ ਗੋਲੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਕੇ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ham hovah laale gole gurasikhaa ke jinhaa anadin har prabh purakh dhiaaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: I am the slave, the servant of the Guru's Sikhs, who meditate on the Lord God, the Primal Being, night and day. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪਗ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: merai man tan birahu gurasikh pag laaiaa ||
lines.translation: Within my mind and body, I have enshrined love for the feet of the Guru's Sikhs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸਖਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਸਿਖ ਭਾਈ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere praan sakhaa gur ke sikh bhaaee mo kau karahu upades har milai milaaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: O my life-mates, O Sikhs of the Guru, O Siblings of Destiny, instruct me in the Teachings, that I might merge in the Lord's Merger. ||1||Pause||
